##### Project general facts

Al Ghaf Tower is a breathtaking 50-floor beachfront landmark rising 210.7 metres above Al Khan, Sharjah, where timeless heritage meets contemporary luxury in perfect harmony. The tower presents a magnificent collection of fully-furnished 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartments, as well as exclusive 4-bedroom duplex residences, totalling 378 homes designed for the finest coastal lifestyle. This iconic development offers sweeping seaside views and an unparalleled living experience along the stunning Al Khan Lagoon.

Al Ghaf Tower is thoughtfully designed to elevate everyday life with an exceptional suite of world-class amenities that cater to wellness, leisure, and social connection. Residents enjoy a spectacular infinity pool, a modern state-of-the-art gym, jogging tracks, a sauna and steam room, jacuzzi, ice dipping pool, and a dedicated massage room for ultimate relaxation. Beautifully landscaped BBQ areas and a vibrant kids' play area complete this extraordinary residential offering, ensuring every moment at home is filled with joy and vitality.

Every residence at Al Ghaf Tower has been meticulously crafted with premium finishes and refined interiors that exude quiet elegance and sophisticated comfort. The living spaces feature warm, textured materials, soft lighting, and thoughtfully designed layouts that create an inviting atmosphere for everyday living and meaningful moments. High-quality fittings and fully furnished interiors reflect Tiger Properties' unwavering commitment to luxury, ensuring that each home is move-in ready and perfectly appointed from day one.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Khan is one of Sharjah’s most established coastal districts, known for its scenic waterfront and relaxed seaside atmosphere. The area is defined by its proximity to Al Khan Beach, offering residents and visitors easy access to the shoreline and open views of the Arabian Gulf. With a blend of modern developments and long-standing residential buildings, Al Khan presents a balanced mix of urban living and coastal charm.

The district is primarily residential, featuring a wide selection of apartment buildings that cater to different lifestyle needs. It is considered a family-friendly area, supported by nearby schools, healthcare facilities, and everyday conveniences. Al Khan is also home to well-known attractions such as the Sharjah Aquarium and maritime museum, while the nearby Al Qasba Canal adds a vibrant leisure component with waterfront promenades and entertainment options.

In addition to its natural appeal, Al Khan offers a range of recreational and lifestyle facilities. Residents can enjoy jogging paths, waterfront walkways, and nearby parks, creating opportunities for outdoor activities. The area benefits from strong connectivity, with direct access to key roads linking Sharjah to Dubai, making daily commuting convenient. A variety of retail outlets, supermarkets, cafes, and restaurants are integrated throughout the district, ensuring a comfortable and well-serviced living environment.
